claims.statement: Tom Allen filed suit against Bill Clark, the final stakeholder in the Daly-McManus match.
claims.excerpt: Allen yesterday entered suit against Bill Clark, the final stakeholder

claims.statement: Allen's petition asked for judgment for $1,000 he had deposited with the stakeholder, with interest and costs.
claims.excerpt: prays judgment for said sum of $1,000, interest and costs

claims.statement: Allen's second count said Bill Clark received a sum printed as $75) from the Globe Printing Co. for Allen and had not paid it.
claims.excerpt: the defendant received from the Globe Printing Co. the sum of $75)

claims.statement: Tom Allen and Dan Daly made a wager on October 16, 1888, depending on a gloved match between Dan Daly and Hugh McManus set for December 1888.
claims.excerpt: he and one Dan Daly enteredintoa wager depending upon the result of a boxin match with gloves between Dan Daly and Hugh McManus

claims.statement: Tom Allen backed Hugh McManus in the match against Dan Daly and claimed a $750 forfeit for him.
claims.excerpt: my claim for $750 forfeit for Hugh McManus

claims.statement: Tom Allen claimed a forfeit at noon on December 5, 1888, saying Daly's final $250 deposit was not up.
claims.excerpt: I heard the next morning that Daly’s #250 was not up so I went to the oflice and at 12 o'clock claimed a forfeit.

claims.statement: A temporary stakeholder said Daly's money was up on time and was turned over to Bill Clark, disputing Allen's forfeit claim.
claims.excerpt: says Daly’s money was up on time and thatthe money was turned over to Clark

claims.statement: The article says Tom Allen had long been on the run from the law and kept out of its clutches.
claims.excerpt: the law has had Tom on the run, and he was compelled to step around pretty lively to keep out of its clutches

quotes.speaker: Tom Allen
quotes.text: Iam willing to leave the matter to the Clipper, the Spirit of the Times or the Police Gazetie, and will abide by their decision on my claim for $750 forfeit for Hugh McManus
quotes.topic: offers to let sporting papers decide his forfeit claim

notes: Allen was not a fighter in the Daly-McManus match; his part was a wager, a forfeit claim and a lawsuit. The Clark amount is printed as $75) and is uncertain.
